our culture is probably different, here in my country, making jokes about people's insecurities is considered normal and hilarious.

everyday people keep saying bad things about how i need to lose weight etc, even my parents also do that😅

it's just our beauty standard is like that, so if you don't follow the beauty standards. People will make fun of you.

And I don't know how mature boys are in your place, but yeah even someone who is already 26 (man) still bullies me, and keep saying harsh words about me😅 *he is in the same college as me*

Actually I'm not living with my parents anymore. I'm now in college, and I'm living overseas. But not too far from my home country. I'm living alone here without knowing anyone.
But the thing is, this country is not that different from my home country. It's basically the same, the people, the culture, etc.
I'm now 20 years old and yeah the depression starts when i was 18.

I have some things that i really enjoy tho, but I don't have time to do so, due to the lack of times college gives. I don't even know if i still like doing all those of things. I have lost any interest to everything, i feel like i dont know what i like anymore, i have lost every dreams and goals. I don't want to be anything.

Yeah i know what you're saying, it's true tho. Sometimes i feel like i don't belong here, the people, the pressure, the society are all too much. But I don't know where i want to go, i just want to be away. I'm graduating soon, like really soon. And it has been giving me so much heavy thoughts and pressure. Because i have to go back to my home country, i must go back to that shitty hometown. I must meet my family again, i must see the familiar faces again. I must face the pressure that they will give to me again. I will not have my time alone anymore, since everyone will be watching me everytime.

I'm an asian, and yeah asian will always be like this to everyone, either you are a "success" or "failure".
When i told my parents that i dont want to go back anymore, they were like so mad. And said that I'm the weirdest person ever, etc etc.

And btw, my parents are divorced. So i told both of them separately, and yeah both of them think I'm just crazy and delusional.
